name: aggregate over one table - the same average written through a table alias
outcome_classes: identical query returns the recorded rows
an aliased rewrite returning the same rows is accepted
the same aggregate over a filtered subset returns different rows and is rejected
a different aggregate over the same table is rejected

input_data.question: Compute the average age of all the dogs.

probes.equivalent_good: SELECT AVG(T1.age) FROM Dogs AS T1
probes.partial: SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = '1'

name: two columns with a filter - the same rows reached through an alias and IN instead of equality
outcome_classes: identical query returns the recorded rows
an aliased IN-predicate rewrite returning the same row is accepted
the same shape with a different filter value is rejected
the same two columns in the other order is a different row and is rejected
expected: SELECT Population ,  LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Brazil"

input_data.question: What are the population and life expectancies in Brazil?

probes.good: SELECT Population ,  LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Brazil"
probes.equivalent_good: SELECT c.Population, c.LifeExpectancy FROM country AS c WHERE c.Name IN ('Brazil')
probes.partial: SELECT LifeExpectancy , Population FROM country WHERE Name = 'Brazil'
probes.bad: SELECT Population , LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Argentina'

name: an ordered listing - the recorded order asked for explicitly, so the reversed order is a wrong answer
outcome_classes: identical query returns the recorded rows in the recorded order
an aliased rewrite that leaves ASC implicit is accepted
the same rows in the opposite order are rejected because the recorded query asked for an order
expected: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC

input_data.question: List the name of singers in ascending order of net worth.

probes.good: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC
probes.equivalent_good: SELECT s.Name FROM singer AS s ORDER BY s.Net_Worth_Millions
probes.partial: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions DESC
probes.bad: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Citizenship = 'France' ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC
